name: Identifying False Teachers
overview: Scripture warns believers to be vigilant against false teachers who disguise themselves as harmless but are inwardly destructive, as Jesus cautions in Matthew 7:15. These deceivers may perform impressive signs and wonders, even threatening to mislead the elect (Matthew 24:24). The apostles exhort the church to guard itself by recognizing those who promote divisive teachings contrary to the gospel once delivered (Romans 16:17; Galatians 1:6) and to avoid such individuals. Church leaders are entrusted with the responsibility to shepherd the flock faithfully, protecting it from those who spread falsehoods and cause spiritual harm (Acts 20:28; Titus 1:10).
